name: Kraft Heinz
outlook:
What Kraft Heinz says to expect

  • Full year 2026: organic net salesOrganic Net Sales (1)(2) down 0.5 percent to down 1.25 percent versus the prior year. This outlook includes an approximate 100 basis point impact from incremental SNAP headwinds.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EPSAdjusted EPS (1)(2) is now expected to be in the range of $2.07 to $2.13. Additionally, the Company expects an effective tax rate on Adjusted EPS of approximately 23.5%, interest expense of approximately $890 million, and other expense/(income) of approximately $210 million of income for the full year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
